Changed: the minds e2e snapshot image build (`scripts/snapshot_minds_e2e_state.py`) no longer uploads the host's `apps/minds/resources/`. It is regenerated inside the image by `ensure-binaries.js`, and at up to 371MB it was the largest single item in the upload. Excluding it also removes a footgun for manual runs: from a macOS host with a populated tree, the staging rsync carried arm64 binaries into the Linux image, where `ensure-binaries` saw them as present and skipped provisioning. CI was unaffected (it stages a clean Linux checkout).
